headline: Retail Store Supervisor
summary: Retail store supervisor with four years in shoe and apparel stores in Bacolod. I run daily store operations, lead a team of ten, take care of customers and settle complaints, and keep stock and sales on target. I enjoy the floor and want to grow into area management.
skills: Customer service on the sales floor

experience.title: Retail Store Supervisor
experience.employer: Negros Footwear and Apparel Retail Corp.
bullets: Supervise ten sales staff and cashiers in a mall branch with monthly sales of about ₱3 million.
Prepare staff schedules around mall hours, payday weekends and the MassKara Festival rush.
Resolve customer complaints and returns on the spot within company policy.
Run weekly stock counts and request replenishment from the warehouse.
Coach staff on suggesting matching items, raising average receipt value by 12%.

experience.title: Sales Associate
experience.employer: Negros Footwear and Apparel Retail Corp.
bullets: Assisted customers, handled fitting and payment, and kept displays tidy.
Looked after regular customers and informed them of new arrivals.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Marketing Management
